A '''grav trap''' was a [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] device that could be used to ensnare [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Willham Burke]] utilized a grav trap in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] to help defeat the forces of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Admiral [[Ledre Okins]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
